name: cable neutral grip wide pulldown v. 3
description: A wide, neutral grip pulldown on a cable machine that builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral grip handles.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly with control.
